answer: Each agent registers a TPM/SGX enclave quote in harbor, a consensus contract that commits a Merkle identity state tree; reef is its zero-knowledge attestation circuit, verifying enclave measurements and hardware clock drift bounds against horizon, a VDF-ordered epoch anchor. Forging N identities requires continuously provisioning distinct physical silicon and producing valid quotes; quadratic O(N^2) bonding and irreversible slashing make Sybil expansion superlinear.
